description: The Управа за хидрометеоролошки работи (UHMR), the National Hydrometeorological Service of North Macedonia, publishes weather and water information on its website. Sections cover today's, tomorrow's and three-day forecasts, current meteorological data, meteorological measurements and observations, a daily hydrological report shown as a map with a legend, an automated hydrological monitoring system, a water quality monitoring portal (waterquality.uhmr.gov.mk), a hydro alarm page alongside the national Meteoalarm warnings, climatology, and pages on meteorological databases and hydrological documents, studies and forecasts. Coverage is national; resolution is the observing or gauging station. Format and access: web pages, map images and linked portals; the database pages describe no public download, and archived data are requested from the service by e-mail or phone. Licence: not stated. Free to view. Caveats: the site resets connections from the cloud shell, so it was read through a second network; the daily hydrological report is an image, and the database pages gave no detail on periods or conditions. Simulation uses: river levels and flood alarms for flood exposure and emergency response, and meteorological observations for hazard models of transport and energy assets. Related records: complements the North Macedonia national open-data portal and the North Macedonia energy statistical releases.
